component.name: Tensorseed Desktop
component.summary: Download, seed, and serve AI models you can verify

description.p: Tensorseed Desktop browses signed, Chia anchored Tensorseed catalogs of open Hugging Face models and datasets. It pulls them over BitTorrent with an HTTP fallback, verifies every file against the signed manifest, and seeds them back to the swarm.

ul.li: Search catalogs and open an entry from a tensorseed:// link
Pull, verify, and seed models and datasets natively
Keep seeding from the system tray
Shares its config and state with the tensorseed command line tool
Serve a verified copy through an OpenAI compatible engine you install separately, with the tensorseed command line tool installed on the host

description.p: First Flatpak build of Tensorseed Desktop.
